en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of an arcade with stone columns and arches overlooking a terraced area with trees and a distant body of water or landscape. The foreground shows a colonnaded walkway; to the left are low stone walls, bare trees, and a path descending toward the background. Printed captions in French and another language identify the scene as Salonique/Salonica – Vláteon-Mouni. A publisher mark and photo credit appear at the bottom.
